pet_bear.description: A massive bear called from the deep woods. Absorbs punishment.
pet_bear.name: Cave Bear

pet_bone_golem.description: Massive construct of fused bones. Slow but devastating.
pet_bone_golem.name: Bone Golem

pet_clockwork_turret.description: A brass tripod turret with a single arcane-blue eye. Springs wound tight, barrel loaded with rune-etched bolts.
pet_clockwork_turret.name: Clockwork Turret

pet_demon.description: A summoned demon beast from the lower planes.
pet_demon.name: Infernal Hound

pet_familiar.description: A mystical black cat wreathed in arcane runes, bound to its mage by ancient pact.
pet_familiar.name: Arcane Familiar

pet_fire_elemental.description: A living flame summoned from the ember planes.
pet_fire_elemental.name: Fire Elemental

pet_imp.description: A mischievous lesser demon. Small but cunning.
pet_imp.name: Bound Imp

pet_lightning_elemental.description: A crackling bolt given form and purpose.
pet_lightning_elemental.name: Lightning Elemental

pet_skeletal_warrior.description: Undead soldier bound by dark magic. Fights with hollow determination.
pet_skeletal_warrior.name: Skeletal Warrior

pet_war_hound.description: An armored hunting dog trained for battle.
pet_war_hound.name: Trained War Hound

pet_wolf.description: A wild wolf bonded through nature magic. Swift and loyal.
pet_wolf.name: Forest Wolf

companions.description: Loyal, fierce, and surprisingly effective against goblins. Bites hard.
companions.name: War Dog

companions.description: A black-furred predator with eyes like coals. Slips between shadows; strikes from behind.
companions.name: Shadow Cat

companions.description: A wolf the size of a horse. Pack instinct, brutal jaws, brutal endurance.
companions.name: Dire Wolf

companions.description: A silent hunter from the Thornwood. Spots ambushes before they trigger.
companions.name: Forest Owl

companions.description: A small fire-tongued drake. Not quite a dragon — but the breath still burns.
companions.name: Ember Drake

companions.description: A construct of living crystal. Slow, heavy, almost unkillable.
companions.name: Crystal Golem

companions.description: A floating mote of pale light. Heals nearby allies just by drifting close.
companions.name: Spirit Wisp

companions.description: A skeletal mastiff bound by old necromantic threads. Tireless. Unafraid.
companions.name: Bone Hound

companions.description: A flickering mote of frost. Hits feel cold long after the fight ends.
companions.name: Ice Sprite

companions.description: A boulder-sized amphibian. Sticky tongue. Tougher than it looks.
companions.name: Swamp Frog

companions.description: Wings of starless black. Drifts between the lines of reality.
companions.name: Void Moth

companions.description: A tiny crimson dragon. Breathes dragon-fire that grows hotter as it matures. One day it will be a true dragon.
companions.name: Crimson Dragon Hatchling

companions.description: A young frost dragon. Its dragon-breath freezes foes in place. Dragon-scales shimmer blue.
companions.name: Frost Wyrmling

companions.description: A lightning-winged dragon. Dragon-thunder crackles in its wake. Fast as a dragon on the hunt.
companions.name: Storm Drake

companions.description: A dragon born of eclipse-fire. Dragon-shadow clings to it, and dragon-whispers answer its call.
companions.name: Shadow Wyrm

hires.description: A quiet ranger from the eastern border. Waits for the perfect shot.
hires.name: Aela
hires.personalityNote: Patient — prefers precise strikes over rushing in.

hires.description: Retired soldier. Bored. Wants one last fight.
hires.name: Borin
hires.personalityNote: Aggressive — always targets the strongest enemy first.

hires.description: Young cleric of the Light. Eager to prove herself outside the temple.
hires.name: Lysa

hires.description: Says he's not a thief. Has three knives.
hires.name: Rekk
hires.personalityNote: Opportunist — strikes weakened enemies to finish them.

hires.description: A dragon-blooded warrior clad in dragon-scale plate. His dragon-fang greatsword has slain three dragons.
hires.name: Kaldrek the Dragonborn
hires.personalityNote: Aggressive — channels dragon-fury against the strongest foe.

hires.description: Sworn to the dragon oaths of old. Her dragon-breath melts armor and her dragon-scales turn blades.
hires.name: Syra Wyrmsworn
hires.personalityNote: Protective — uses dragon-scales to shield allies from dragon-fire.

hires.description: Raised inside a dragon-hoard by a red dragon that mistook him for a hatchling. Believes he IS a dragon.
hires.name: Vorin Emberjaw
hires.personalityNote: Patient — waits for the dragon-moment, then unleashes dragon-fury.

hires.description: A dragon-cult defector. Her dragon-tattoos glow when dragons are near. Carries dragon-tooth daggers as backup.
hires.name: Maelis Drakeblood
hires.personalityNote: Opportunist — strikes when the dragon-heat is at its peak.

hires.description: Workshop-trained mechanist with brass goggles and more pockets than fingers. Can fix a clockwork or fix a wound in the same minute.
hires.name: Ysolde Cogwright
hires.personalityNote: Opportunist — grenades the clumped, bolts the stragglers.
